title: Russell Brand goes to prison – level 1
paragraphs: A London court says that famous British actor Russell Brand is guilty of big crimes. He hurts four women and must now go to prison for a long time.

Police say that more women will likely come and tell their stories now. The police say that it is good that women can speak. People will believe them now. The British prime minister thanks the women who tell the truth about Brand’s bad actions.
Police are still looking into other stories about him. Brand will find out his time in prison soon.
